heading_en: Transitional Measures Concerning the Use of Ratings That Do Not Take Implicit Government Support into Account
summary_ja: 新告示第三十条第三項を六年間適用しない。
summary_en: Article 30, paragraph (3) of the New Public Notice does not apply for six years from the Application Date.
paragraphs: Article 30, paragraph (3) of the New Public Notice does not apply for the period until the day on which six years have elapsed from the Application Date.
